cases.name: 85 official topics, 170 chapters, 79 ordinary and 6 exploration
Legacy template IDs remain available for historical generation
All active normal templates generate at 40 real deterministic seeds; canonical answers grade correctly
Every ordinary topic can open both chapters and produce a scoped test, including small-pool fallback
P1 subtraction never borrows; P1 basic add/sub use valid one-digit decomposition
P2 arithmetic constraints differ between 2N2 and 2N5
P6 percentage tasks exclude discount and interest; use versioned new models
P3 accepts unsimplified fractions; P4+ require simplest and accept improper or mixed
Hinted first practice answers remain assisted; feedback cannot overwrite the first attempt
Exam answers persist before marking; blank/invalid answers are recorded at submission
Submitting twice is idempotent for history, attempts and reward ledger
Wrong answers produce teaching links and cannot be cleared by same-day correction
Cross-grade/F exploration/malformed refs are rejected without resetting source
Stored examination draft survives JSON round-trip with identical questions and answers
Exploration notes have no automatic score, mastery or coin
